name: Women Scientist Scheme-B
teBrief: ఆచరణీయమైన ఎస్ & టి జోక్యాల ద్వారా సామాజిక సవాళ్లను పరిష్కరించడంలో ఆసక్తి ఉన్న వారి కెరీర్లో విరామం ఉన్న మహిళా అభ్యర్థులకు ఎంఓఎస్టి రీసెర్చ్ గ్రాంట్.
brief: A Research Grant by MoST for female candidates with break in their career interested in addressing societal challenges through viable S&T interventions.
briefFull: A Research Grant by MoST for female candidates with break in their career interested in addressing societal challenges through viable S&T interventions.
details:
A Research Grant by MoST for female candidates with break in their career interested in addressing societal challenges through viable S&T interventions.

This scheme will provide a research grant for a well-defined project proposal for a period of maximum three years. This grant will cover the fellowship of the applicant and cost of small equipments, contingencies, travel, consumables, etc. Institutional overhead charges will be extra.

Women scientists who wish to apply under this scheme are required to develop their own project/proposals for scientific and technological solutions to address issues preferably at enhance quality-of-life the grassroots level. 

The proposal must clearly bring out the societal benefit to be accrued through well conceived plan for development of technology/technique and/or adaptation/ customization. The candidate should have adequate S&T skills and be adept at techniques to deliver the proposed outcome.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a FEMALE.
1. The applicant must either be unemployed or in a position other than regular/permanent position.
1. The age of the applicant must be between 27 and 57 years (5 year relaxation for SC/ST/OBC and physically challenged candidates)
1. The applicant must hold either of the following Minimum essential qualification - a)   Minimum Post Graduate degree, equivalent to M.Sc. in Basic or Applied Sciences or B.Tech. or MBBS or other equivalent professional qualifications;    b)   M.Phil/M.Tech/M.Pharm/M.VSc or equivalent qualifications;   c)   Ph.D. in Basic or Applied Sciences.
documentsRequired:
- Project Proposal Document (Refer source for Format)
- Biodata of PI (Signed) (Refer source for Format)
- Mentor’s Biodata (Signed)
- Caste Certificate (If SC/ST/OBC/PH)
- DOB certificate (10th class passed only)
- Photograph of PI
- Signature of PI
- Highest Degree
- House Rent Allowance (if Eligible) (Refer source for Format)

faqs.q: Is there a validity to the scheme benefits?
faqs.a: The benefits are provided for a period of maximum three years.

faqs.q: What would be the mode of payment of the scholarship?
faqs.a: The payment of the scholarship will be through DBT.

faqs.q: What benefits are covered under Project Cost?
faqs.a: The Project Cost consists of Fellowship of Principal Investigator (PI), Consumables, Travel, Contingencies, and Minor Equipment but excluding HRA and overheads.
faqs.qTe: ప్రాజెక్ట్ వ్యయం కింద ఏ ప్రయోజనాలు ఉంటాయి?

faqs.q: Will I be eligible for the scholarship if I fail to get promoted to the next semester?
faqs.a: No. The scholarship will be terminated in that case.
faqs.qTe: నేను తదుపరి సెమిస్టర్కు పదోన్నతి పొందడంలో విఫలమైతే స్కాలర్షిప్కు అర్హత పొందుతానా?

faqs.q: Can I apply offline for the scholarship?
faqs.a: No. You need to visit https://online-wosa.gov.in/wosb/ to apply.
faqs.qTe: నేను స్కాలర్షిప్ కోసం ఆఫ్లైన్లో దరఖాస్తు చేయవచ్చా?

faqs.a: No. The entire application process is completely free of cost.

faqs.q: Which scientific disciplines are covered under this grant?
faqs.a:
Agriculture, Food and Environmental Challenges (AFE) Strengthening Health Care and Nutrition (HN)
Energy (ER)
Water and Waste Management (WWM)
Engineering and IT Solutions to Societal Issues (EIT) Harnessing Advances in Artificial Intelligence (AI)
faqs.qTe: ఈ గ్రాంట్ కింద ఏ శాస్త్రీయ విభాగాలు ఉన్నాయి?

faqs.q: Is it possible to pursue PhD along with a  WOS-B project?
faqs.a: Yes, the beneficiary is allowed to do so.
faqs.qTe: డబ్ల్యూఓఎస్-బి ప్రాజెక్టుతో పాటు పీహెచ్డీ చేయడం సాధ్యమేనా?

faqs.q: I am 24 years in age. Can I apply for the scheme?
faqs.a: Women scientists, less than 27 years of age are not eligible.
faqs.qTe: నా వయసు 24 సంవత్సరాలు. నేను ఈ పథకానికి దరఖాస్తు చేయవచ్చా?

faqs.q: Do I need to complete the application in one sitting?
faqs.a: No. You can save the application as draft and continue at a later time before the deadline.
faqs.qTe: నేను ఒకే సిట్టింగ్లో దరఖాస్తును పూర్తి చేయాల్సిన అవసరం ఉందా?

faqs.q: What should be the type and size of the documents to be uploaded?
faqs.a: The format should be.pdf. The size of each document should not be greater than 2MB.
faqs.qTe: అప్లోడ్ చేయవలసిన పత్రాల రకం మరియు పరిమాణం ఎంత ఉండాలి?

faqs.q: How do I know if a field in the application form is mandatory?
faqs.a: The mandatory fields have a red asterisk (*) mark at the end.
faqs.qTe: దరఖాస్తు ఫారంలో ఒక ఫీల్డ్ తప్పనిసరి అని నాకు ఎలా తెలుస్తుంది?

faqs.q: I have a query regarding the application process. Whom should I contact regarding the same?
faqs.a: For further inquiries regarding WOS-B please send email to: wosb-dst@gov.in
faqs.qTe: దరఖాస్తు ప్రక్రియకు సంబంధించి నాకు ఒక ప్రశ్న ఉంది. దీనికి సంబంధించి నేను ఎవరిని సంప్రదించాలి?

faqs.q: Do I need to apply as a PI or as a Mentor?
faqs.a: The applicant must apply as Principal Investigator. Mentor will not be considered as an  applicant.
faqs.qTe: నేను పిఐగా లేదా మెంటార్గా దరఖాస్తు చేసుకోవాల్సిన అవసరం ఉందా?

faqs.q: Is there a deadline for submitting the hard copy of the online application?
faqs.a: Hard copy of submitted online application has to reach the department within twenty days from the last date of online submission of proposals including extended period, if any.
faqs.qTe: ఆన్లైన్ దరఖాస్తు యొక్క హార్డ్ కాపీని సమర్పించడానికి గడువు ఉందా?
